title: tabebuia pallida subsp. heterophylla
intro: Tabebuia pallida subsp. heterophylla, commonly known as the Pink Trumpet Tree, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cold, and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Tabebuia pallida subsp. heterophylla include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
